items.title: Dragon Ball DAIMA Complete Collection
items.description:
Due to a conspiracy, Goku and friends are transformed into children. They intend to travel to a mysterious new world to undo this change.

This complete archive includes:
All Subbed episodes (1-20)
All Dubbed episodes (1-20)
All trailers and promotional videos Toei
